Using higher-energy collisional dissociation data from human immunoglobulin γ (IgG) and human fibrinogen tryptic digests, we show that glyXtool<sup>MS</sup> enables a fast, flexible, and transparent analysis of N- and O-glycopeptide samples, providing the user a versatile tool even for explorative data analysis.
